description: A node's port-forwarding prerequisites (P11, ADR 0022). Prerequisites, not a credential: the provider credential is held by the platform and delivered per request, so a node has nothing to report about it. These four booleans exist so the platform can distinguish the four ways port forwarding fails before a user presses anything - without them every one of them reaches the UI as "could not open a tunnel". `veto` is the node owner's refusal and the platform must never override it.
